reflections.label: Elbow swelling
reflections.learned: Warmth over a bursa needs a temperature and a look for a portal of entry.
reflections.next: Check for a portal of entry first.
reflections.summary: A patient in their forties presented with a week of painless swelling over one elbow, warm to the touch, with no injury. Olecranon bursitis was suspected and rest with anti-inflammatory treatment agreed.
